privacyDetails.title: What data is collected?
privacySettings.title: Privacy & data
privacyDetails.choice.title: Your choice
privacyDetails.choice.body: You can choose diagnostics, usage analytics and additional school & grade statistics separately. The app works without optional data. A new notice version requires a new decision.
privacyDetails.required.title: Required processing
privacyDetails.required.body: The app communicates with your selected school register, handles authentication and sessions, and stores settings and cached register data locally where applicable. Calendar synchronization and file access provide functions you request. This processing is separate from optional Firebase services.
privacyDetails.crashes.title: Firebase Crashlytics diagnostics
privacyDetails.crashes.body: Only after consent, technical error reports help identify crashes and problems with particular app versions or devices. We do not set a school account identifier.
privacyDetails.automatic.title: Automatic technical crash data
privacyDetails.automatic.body: Depending on the SDK and platform: exception type, technical message, stack trace, time and fatal/non-fatal classification; app package, version and build; OS, device model, CPU architecture, memory/storage information, root/jailbreak, foreground/background and orientation. Technical installation/session identifiers, threads, binary images and native addresses may be included. Native signals and Android NDK crash data are platform-specific. Proximity sensor state may be supplied by the SDK; the app does not read sensors for diagnostics. Available build metadata may help identify builds. Not all fields are available on every platform.
privacyDetails.context.title: Additional technical context
privacyDetails.context.body: Current/previous screen, lifecycle, demo and login status, technical provider category; API version/environment, normalized endpoint, method, status, request type and response format; network availability, connection category where known, retries and timeouts; cache settings/hits and technical storage/migration versions; semester, tab and predefined filter; theme and language; notification availability/category; background task, sync status/result; data source, parser, feature and operation; first launch, detected upgrade and previous app version; installation source, build flavor, release channel, Flutter/Dart versions and backend reachability where reliable. Unavailable values remain unknown.
privacyDetails.logs.title: Diagnostic logs
privacyDetails.logs.body: Short predefined technical steps may accompany errors: screen opened, request started, cache hit or synchronization failed. Passwords, tokens, grades and personal text are excluded.
privacyDetails.excluded.title: What we do not send to Crashlytics
privacyDetails.excluded.body: No passwords, access/refresh tokens, authorization headers, cookies, API secrets or register credentials. No usernames, email addresses, names, student/teacher/account IDs, school names or exact classes. No grades/averages, homework text, absence reasons, health information, absence notes, private notes, search text or notification contents. No API request/response payloads, raw URLs or personal URL parameters. No advertising identifiers, precise location, Wi-Fi names or IP collection implemented by us.
privacyDetails.analytics.title: Usage analytics
privacyDetails.analytics.body: After consent: fixed screen and feature names, actions, login and load results, cache, sync, filters, semester, language and theme. Errors and durations are categories. Properties include provider, demo mode, language, theme, academic year and build category; school ID only with additional statistics consent. No text inputs or register contents.
privacyDetails.control.title: Changing settings
privacyDetails.control.body: Change separate choices and age eligibility in Settings > Privacy & Data. Information pages and Customize do not save consent. Only a confirmed choice is saved.
privacyDetails.limits.title: Withdrawal and platforms
privacyDetails.limits.body: Withdrawal blocks new optional diagnostics, disables Firebase collection and deletes locally unsent crash reports. It does not delete records already uploaded to Firebase. Windows and Linux use no Firebase diagnostic/analytics collection. Firebase may use technical installation/session identifiers, which are not school account identifiers.
privacySettings.allow: Allow optional diagnostics and usage data
privacyCategory.diagnostics.title: Error diagnostics
privacyCategory.diagnostics.body: Technical crash and error data help us find problems in the app.
privacyCategory.usage.title: Usage analytics
privacyCategory.usage.body: Pseudonymous usage data show which features are used. The school ID is sent only with additional school and grade statistics consent.
privacyCategory.academic.title: School & grade statistics
privacyCategory.academic.body: In addition to usage analytics: locally calculated overall grade average to one decimal and count buckets for aggregate statistics. No individual grades or register content.
privacyDetails.identity.title: Pseudonymous identity
privacyDetails.identity.body: With usage analytics the app uses a random identifier per locally saved account and installation. It contains no name, email or credentials. It groups usage and reduces repeated counting. The same person on multiple devices can be counted more than once. These data are pseudonymous, not anonymous.
privacyDetails.school.title: School association
privacyDetails.school.body: Only with usage analytics and additional statistics consent can the selected school be sent as a stable internal ID. Ambiguous associations send no ID. School names and demo schools are excluded.
privacyDetails.academic.title: Pseudonymous school and performance statistics
privacyDetails.academic.body: Only with additional consent: overall average calculated locally as in the app and rounded to one decimal, academic year, semester and grade/subject count buckets. The contribution is linked to your pseudonymous identifier and internal school ID. No individual grades, subject names or averages, teachers, comments or attendance data. Demo data are excluded. The purpose is aggregate averages; school groups may only be published with at least 30 distinct pseudonymous identifiers. Changes can produce new contributions.
privacyDetails.analyticsAutomatic.title: Automatic technical Analytics data
privacyDetails.analyticsAutomatic.body: After consent Firebase also collects its own technical usage information, such as sessions, app version, OS, device category/model and engagement. Details depend on platform and SDK. Automatic screen reporting and advertising ID collection remain disabled. Firebase adds event timestamps; the app adds no precise timestamps.
privacyDetails.revocation.title: Revocation
privacyDetails.revocation.body: Revocation stops future optional collection on this device. When usage analytics is revoked we clear the Analytics identity and app properties in the SDK and reset local Analytics data. Data already processed or uploaded are not automatically erased on the server. This app has no automatic server-side deletion workflow.
privacyDetails.analyticsExcluded.title: What we never send to Analytics
privacyDetails.analyticsExcluded.body: No passwords, access/refresh tokens, session cookies, authorization headers, usernames, emails, real names, student/teacher names or school account IDs. No exact class/section, individual grades, subject names or averages, homework text, messages, absence reasons, sickness/health information, free-text notes or search text. No API request/response bodies, raw URLs with IDs/parameters, notification text, precise GPS location, Wi-Fi SSID/BSSID or advertising ID added by the app. Only with additional consent may the reduced overall average be sent as academic statistics.

grades.forecast.body: The forecast is a statistical estimate, not an official report-card grade. It estimates future performance from your weighted grades, giving more influence to recent grades (30-day half-life). Assuming the same assessment frequency, these are combined with grades already earned through the end of the school year. All subjects count equally. Cancelled grades, grades with no weight and excluded subjects do not count. At least four grades on three days are needed. New grades can change the result.

privacyDetails.notice.title: Privacy notice – version 5
privacyDetails.notice.body: Updated: 3 October 2026, version 5. Controller for this app fork: Tobias Bucci, Mühlenweg 51, St. Sigmund, Italy (Bolzano). Privacy contact: buccitobias774@gmail.com. The legal roles of the school and register provider for register processing require separate review.
privacyDetails.local.title: Local storage and register data
privacyDetails.local.body: Saved credentials use secure device storage. Settings, consent and optional register caches stay locally. Register data may include grades, timetable, messages, homework and absences, including health-related reasons. They support register functions and are excluded from telemetry. Study notes and file copies stay locally. Calendar sync writes requested events to your chosen device calendar; its provider may sync them. Remove files and calendar events separately there. Accounts and caches can be removed in the app or by clearing app data; operating-system backups may exist separately.
privacyDetails.basis.title: Purposes and consent
privacyDetails.basis.body: Diagnostics, usage analytics and pseudonymous school/grade statistics are three optional purposes based on your consent. Each can be withdrawn separately. School statistics also require usage consent. Core functions do not depend on optional consent. The legal basis and roles for necessary register processing still require review.
privacyDetails.retention.title: Retention and deletion
privacyDetails.retention.body: Local data remain until deletion, cache replacement or account removal; there is no uniform period. According to project information GA4 uses 14 months with reset on new activity; this does not automatically apply to all aggregate reports. BigQuery raw data need a separate deletion rule: the target is at most about 14 months; the actual period needs verification. Google describes 90 days for Crashlytics before removal from live and backup systems begins. Withdrawal stops future collection and clears local SDK data, without automatically deleting uploaded server records.
privacyDetails.recipients.title: Recipients and international processing
privacyDetails.recipients.body: Your selected register provider receives requests needed for login and register functions. With the relevant consent Google/Firebase processes optional Analytics or Crashlytics data. Technical network metadata such as IP addresses may arise. Firebase processing may be international; an EU BigQuery dataset does not guarantee EU-only processing for all Firebase services. Applicable Google contracts, subprocessors and transfer safeguards require review before publication. External support, project and update links open services with their own privacy rules.
privacyDetails.rights.title: Your privacy rights
privacyDetails.rights.body: Under applicable privacy rules you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction and, where applicable, portability or object to processing. You may withdraw consent for the future at any time and complain to the competent data protection authority. In Italy this is the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali. The app has no automatic server-side deletion process. Do not share passwords or health data in public support requests. Send privacy requests to buccitobias774@gmail.com.
